answer: An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the pigment index resolves every citation against the crystal checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the basalt audit keeps the resolved set. Each duplicate costs another 41 dollars in locked collateral and another 10 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
